|DESCRIPTION=
'''Terrain Builder''' is a terrain creation tool. It allows users to build their own virtual worlds from scratch. It is a successor to [[Visitor 3]].
 
|NOTES=Buldozer (the viewer) won't work as expected if you run {{PAGENAME}} from Steam or from [[Arma 3: Tools Launcher]] if this last was ran from Steam. The best case of use is to run [[Arma 3: Tools Launcher]] from the installation directory and run {{PAGENAME}} from it.
